data_integrity: Seven embedded complete UTF-8 artifacts; source-code proof replays complete base-four assignment universe and all-pairs component distances. All source filenames and internal encoded integer ranges fixed explicitly.
scientific_limitations: Exact exhaustive finite classification of the single Grötzsch graph, not an infinite-family theorem. The previously published 12,480-colouring count is not claimed as new; novelty concerns component structure, distances, and symmetry. Residual risk: equivalent unindexed results and inaccessible full text on related Mycielski-graph topics. No external audit.
title: Two recolouring chambers of the Grötzsch graph
